breaking.text: In the response of the invoice API, the total field is now called incl_tax: the API clients and the accounting export must read incl_tax instead of total.

notes: Breaking change: the total including all taxes of an invoice is returned by the API under the name incl_tax, no longer total. Everything that reads total (API clients, accounting export) must be adapted before the update.
Invoice lines now carry a VAT rate, 0.20 by default for existing lines.
A decimal quantity no longer skews the total excluding tax of an invoice.
